allowedSourceMaterial.overview: Goofy’s teenage son Max is desperate to impress his crush and fit in at school. After well-meaning but ignorant Goofy suddenly whisks him away on a cross-country road trip—messing up Max’s first date plans in the process—Goofy’s old-school parenting and Max’s desire for independence lead to a vacation of hilarious mishaps, as they both learn to see eye to eye and listen to each other.

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: With a high-stakes date hanging in the balance, can Max survive his dad's old-school vacation before their clashing agendas derail the journey entirely?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: Max wants to impress his high school crush, but his plans are abruptly derailed when his well-meaning father, Goofy, whisks him away on an unexpected cross-country road trip packed with chaotic mishaps.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Lighthearted, fast-paced, and warm, this breezy animated family adventure offers easy laughs with gentle emotional weight.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: This energetic animated comedy balances slapstick road-trip adventure with an honest father-son dynamic, delivering genuine warmth in a brisk 78-minute journey.
